text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: One day, {0} happened to see a man talking to Eriko in town.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ある日{0}は街中で
エリコが男性に話しかけられているのを見かけた。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: ...As I have told you many times already, I have no intention of doing it again. Please leave.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ですから、
何度も言っているように
もうやるつもりはございませんわ。
どうぞお引き取りを。

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Please, I beg you! I need the help of the one they call the "Legendary Instructor"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこをどうか頼む！
伝説の教官といわれた
あなたの力が必要なんだ！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Oh, my Beloved! You see, this individual seeks to recruit me as an instructor.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
あなた様！　
実はこちらの方が
私に教官をやってほしいというのです。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: It seems the recruit training I conducted for the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE has become quite the talk of the town.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうやら
先の【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】での新兵訓練が
巷で評判になっているようですわ。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Apparently, they've started calling me the "Legendary Instructor". Me, the "Destroyer", receiving such a title... Kus kus.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんでも
「伝説の教官」、
なんて呼ばれているみたいですよ？
「壊し屋」の私が
「伝説の教官」、
だなんて……
クスクス。

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: ...I was surprised to hear that you're the "Destroyer", but I also believe you're the only one with the power to pull this off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
あなたがあの「壊し屋」だってのは驚いたけど、
それくらいのパワーがある人じゃないと
きっとダメだと思う。

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: So please... Please help my friend who's become a shut-in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからどうか、
どうか引きこもっちまった友人を助けてやってくれ！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Yeah, my friend and I have been doing track and field since our student days, and he was especially talented and seemed destined for an elite career, winning countless competitions.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
俺と友人は
学生時代から陸上競技をやっていてさ、
あいつは特に優秀で
エリート街道まっしぐら、
数々の大会を制してきたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: But... when the stage became national, there were tons of people who were on par with him, or even better. He couldn't win as easily as he wanted, and he was forced to realize that he wasn't special.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
舞台が全国になるとあいつと同等、
もしくは
それ以上のヤツがごまんといた。
思うように勝てなくなり、
自分が特別じゃないって思い知らされたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: His pride was wounded, and suffering from his first major setback, he quit track and field and became a shut-in...
text_block_list.orig_text:
プライドを傷つけられ、
はじめての挫折に苦しんだあいつは
陸上をやめて
自宅に引きこもっちまったんだ……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Kus kus... Human hearts really are fragile things.
text_block_list.orig_text:
クスクス、
人の心というものはもろいものですね。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Even if you were to get such a person out of their room, their excessive pride would surely get in the way, making it difficult for them to reintegrate into society.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのような人を部屋から出したとしても、
高すぎるプライドがきっと邪魔をして
社会復帰は難しいでしょう。

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you nailed what the real problem is. Even if I could somehow drag him out of his house, the real question is whether a man who once stood at the top could adapt to live a normal life with a normal job...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
問題はそこなんだ。
よしんば引きずり出せても、
かつて頂点に立った男が
普通の生活や仕事をできるかどうか……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: In that case, just leave him alone. Going through all that extra trouble isn't worth it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ならば、
ほうっておけばいいのです。
わざわざ余計な苦労をする必要などありませんわ。

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Haha, that's harsh. But... even so, we're friends. I can't leave him alone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はは、
手厳しいな。
でも、
それでも友人だからさ、
ほっとけないんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: WHOAAAA! I GET IT! I KNOW EXACTLY HOW YOU FEEL!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおおー！　
分かる、
分かるぞその気持ち！

text_block_list.name: Male 3
text_block_list.text: Friendship is a complex and precious thing that cannot be explained by any mathematical formula.
text_block_list.orig_text:
友情というのは
いかなる数式でも解き明かせない
複雑で尊いものですからね。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Could it be, you guys are here for the same reason?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
もしかしてあなたたちも？

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: You bet! My buddy's currently a full-time shut-in too. That guy, once know as the "King of Destruction", has holed himself up after just one defeat...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おうよ！　
俺のダチも絶賛引きこもり中だ。
かつては破壊王と呼ばれたあいつが、
一度の敗北で
引きこもっちまうなんてよぉ……

text_block_list.name: Male 3
text_block_list.text: It would be a great loss to humanity to keep the brilliant mind of my friend, a child prodigy, locked away in a dark room. Please... I beg you, lend us your support!
text_block_list.orig_text:
神童と讃えられた彼の頭脳を、
暗い部屋に閉じ込めておくなんて
人類の損失です。
どうか、
どうかお力を貸してください！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: I'm not asking you to raise him so that he can return to that same stage. But... at the very least, I want him to return to the outside world. I want him to live with a smile on his face, just like he used to! Please, lend me your strength!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう一度同じ舞台に、
とは言わない。
でもせめて、
外に出てきてほしいんだ。
昔のあいつみたいに
笑顔で暮らしてほしいんだ！　
どうか
力を貸してくれ！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Kus kus. I respectfully refuse.
text_block_list.orig_text:
クスクス。
お断りいたします。

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: N-No way... But you're the legendary instructor!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんな……
あんた
「伝説の教官」なんじゃねえのかよ！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: That's just the name you all have given me. The reason I became an instructor in the first place was for a most important purpose.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはあなたたちが勝手に呼んでいるだけですわ。
そもそも教官をやっていたのは
大事な目的があったからです。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Your friendship is admirable, but you are not my friends, and I gain nothing from helping you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなた方の友情は美しいものですが、
私の友達ではありませんし、
手を貸したところで私にはなんのメリットもありませんわ。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: I suppose there is nothing wrong with what you are saying, my Beloved... but I cannot quite understand it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなた様の言うことに間違いはないでしょうが、
少々わかりかねますわ。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: ...Of course, that's what you'd say. However...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
やはりあなた様はそうおっしゃるのですね。
しかし……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: ...You are unfair, my Beloved. You know full well I cannot refuse a request from you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ズルいおかたですわ。
私があなた様の頼みを断れないと
ご存知なのに
そのようなことをおっしゃるのですもの。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: I cannot fully discern your true intent... but very well. Out of consideration for my Beloved, I shall return to my role as instructor once more.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お言葉の真意は図りかねますが……
いいでしょう。
あなた様に免じて
今一度教官の座に返り咲くとしましょう。

text_block_list.name: Male 3
text_block_list.text: Really?! I'm grateful!
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当ですか！　
助かります！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: However, I will do this my way. Even if, in the worst case, they end up beyond recovery, I expect no complaints.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただし、
この件は私の流儀でやらせていただきますわ。
最悪、
再起不能になったとしても、
文句など言われませんように。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Now then, how shall I train my subjects this time? I'm itching to get started, kus kus. Kus kus kus...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
今度はどう鍛えてさしあげましょうか。
腕が鳴りますわ、
クスクス。
クスクスクス……！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: ...We're here. This is his place. Let me talk to him first, just watch.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──着いたよ、
ここがあいつの家だ。
まずは俺が声をかけるから
見ててくれ。

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's me. I know you're in there. Could you come out for a bit? There's someone I want you to meet today. So...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーい、
俺だ、
いるんだろ？　
ちょっと出てきてくれないか？
今日は
お前に会わせたい人がいるんだ。
だから──

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: No matter how many times you try, the answer's the same! I told you to leave me alone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何度来ても同じだ！　
ほっといてくれって言ってんだろ！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that's how it goes every time. He won't even give me the time of day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
とまあ、
毎度こんな感じで
取り付く島もないんだ。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: I see. I understand perfectly. Then let us have him come out at once. There.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど、
よくわかりました。
それではさっそく出てきてもらいましょう。
そーれ。

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: E-Eeek! W-W-What's going on? A robbery...?! I-I-I don't have any valuables!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひ、
ひぃっ！　
な、
なな
なんだ、
強盗か……！
か、
かか
金目の物なんて
ウチにはないぞ！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Being called a robber is quite the offense. I came here at the request of your friend. Now, let's go. Your grace period is over.
text_block_list.orig_text:
強盗なんて心外ですわ。
あなたのご友人に頼まれて来ました。
さあ、
参りましょう。
モラトリアムはもうお終いですわ。

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? Stop messing with me! Who allowed you to run your mouth?! I'm absolutely not going out... UGYAAAH!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はぁ？　
ふざけるな！　
勝手なこと言ってんじゃねえぞ！
俺は絶対に出な、
うっぎゃあー！？

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: I suggest you stop struggling. Bones are not all that different from twigs.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あまり暴れないほうがいいですわ。
骨なんて小枝とさほど変わりませんから。

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: OUCH! T-They're gonna break for real! I'm going to come out! I will! So let me go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いでー！　
お、
折れる！　
で、
出るよ、
出るから
は、
離してくれぇー！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: As promised, I brought him out. It was easier than I expected. You could have saved so much time and effort if you'd have taken such a measure from the start. Kus kus...
text_block_list.orig_text:
約束通り連れ出しました。
思いのほか簡単でしたわ。
最初からこうすれば
手間も時間も省けましたのに。
クスクス……

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Ha-haha... The Destroyer... sure lives up to her name...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハ、
ハハ……
「壊し屋」
恐るべし、
だな……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Using the same method, Eriko successfully dragged the remaining two out of their rooms as well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そしてエリコは同様の手口で残る二人も
部屋から引きずり出すことに成功した。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Now, hello everyone. I'm Eriko, your instructor. From now on, you will undergo rehabilitation training under my supervision.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
皆さんご機嫌よう。
私はエリコ、
あなたたちの教官です。
これからみなさんは
私の下で社会復帰の訓練を受けていただきます。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you. Kus kus kus.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうぞよろしくお願いしますわ、
クスクスクス。

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: Dragging me all the way out here for this... Don't screw with me! You used force and now you want to instruct me to get back in society? Are you out of your mind?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなとこまで連れ出しやがって、
ふざけんじゃねえぞコラァ！
無理やり連れだして教官だ社会復帰だ？　
頭沸いてんのかテメェ？

text_block_list.name: Former Student
text_block_list.text: He's absolutely right. Look, the arm you grabbed is bruised. This is a clear case of assault and kidnapping. I'm going to sue you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
全くだね。
見たまえ、
君に掴まれた腕がアザになってるじゃないか。
これは立派な傷害事件であり誘拐だ。
訴えてやるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Aah... I don't mind being sued, but what exactly are you planning to say?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ、
訴えるのは構いませんが、
いったいなんとおっしゃるつもりなのですか？

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Surely you're not planning to admit that you lost to a younger girl? Most people would be far too embarrassed to say that out loud.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか年下の女子に負けたなんて、
普通ならとても恥ずかしくて口にできないと思いますが。

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I-I admit you're ridiculously strong, but I let my guard down back then. If we fought normally, I wouldn't lose!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ……
テ、
テメェが馬鹿力なのは認めるが、
あん時は油断があったんだ。
普通にやれば負けやしねえ！

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: Yeah, with my legs I'd have left you in the dust instantly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
俺の脚力なら
速攻でぶっちぎってたぜ。

text_block_list.name: Former Student
text_block_list.text: Earlier I was caught off guard by your sudden attack, but I've already calculated countless paths to victory. I won't make the same mistake again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
先ほどは突然の侵略行為に驚かされたけど、
すでに無数の勝ちパターンを見つけている。
二度と不覚はとらないさ。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Kus kus! You maggots sure love to bark.
text_block_list.orig_text:
クスクス、
ドブ虫どもが吠えてますわ。

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: W-WHO THE HELL ARE YOU CALLING A MAGGOT, OI!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
誰がドブ虫だコラァ！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: I understand that you don't agree with my methods. Then, as a compromise... we'll have a match where you can use your respective strengths.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたたちが私のやり方に納得できないのはわかりました。
それでは私と、
あなたたちの得意分野で勝負しましょう。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: If you are able to beat me at your supposed best, then I assume you won't need any training. You'll be free to return to your room or whatever.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで私に勝てたのなら
訓練の必要はありません。
部屋に戻るなりなんなり
お好きになさってください。

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: R-Really? If I can beat you, I'm free?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ、
本当、
だな？　
あんたに勝てたら
好きにしていいんだな？

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: All right! Hey guys, let's do this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よっしゃあ！　
おうお前ら、
やってやろうぜ！

text_block_list.name: Former Student
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's show this impertinent little girl what an adult can do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
生意気な小娘に
大人の本気を見せてあげよう。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Looks like I didn't even have to count to 10. This makes it 17 consecutive wins for me, but of course you'll continue, right? After all, you're the one known as the "King of Destruction".
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ、
10カウントは……
必要なさそうですね。
これで私の17連勝ですが、
当然まだ続けますよね？
だってあなたは
「破壊王」と呼ばれた人なんですから。

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: This cannot be... For me to lose... to a little girl like her... I-I'm the "King of Destruction"... I, I...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ウソだ……
こんな
小娘に、
俺が……
お、
俺は
「破壊王」なんだ……
俺は、
俺は
……！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: ...And that makes geography my win as well. That's four wins in a row, following math, literature, and history. Are you perhaps going easy on me? Is this the adult composure you prided yourself in?
text_block_list.orig_text:
──はい、
地理も私の勝ちです。
数学、
文学、
歴史に続いて４連勝ですわ。
もしかして
手加減してくれてますか？　
大人の余裕というものですか？

text_block_list.name: Former Student
text_block_list.text: I-Impossible... My brain can handle such subject so easily... Just where did I miscalculate...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ありえない……
僕の頭脳が
こうもたやすく……
いったい、
どこで計算を間違えたんだ……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Oh dear! You've gone pale. We haven't even run that much yet... An elite athlete should have no trouble with this, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
顔が青いですよ？　
まだ大して走ってませんが、
エリートならこれくらいどうってことありませんよね？

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: Uuu... Ugh... I-I can't take it anymore... I refuse to run any longer... It's... It's my loss...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぶ、
う、
ぐうぅ……
も、
もうイヤだ……
走りたく、
ない……
お、
俺の、
負け……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: I couldn't hear you. Please speak louder and more clearly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
聞こえませんね。
もう一度大きな声で、
はっきりとおっしゃってください。

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: IT'S MY LOSS! SO PLEASE LET ME OFF THE HOOK ALREADY!
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺の負けだあ！　
だから、
もう許してくれえー！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: I see. Well then, you'll have to obey my methods from now on. You two have no objections to move either, correct?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですか。
では
今後私のやり方に従っていただきます。
そちらの二人も
文句はありませんね？

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Damn it... Just do whatever you want...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
チクショウ……
どうにでもしやがれ……

text_block_list.name: Former Student
text_block_list.text: It's over... I'm a worthless simpleton...
text_block_list.orig_text:
終わった……
僕には何の価値もありはしないさ……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Good grief. What's the point of getting depressed now?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれやれ、
今更何を落ち込んでいるのですか？

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: To begin with, aren't you simply pathetic little insects who mistook yourselves for being at the top, only to drop out after losing once or twice?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そもそもあなたたちは自分が頂点だと勘違いし、
一度や二度の敗北で
簡単にドロップアウトしたダメ虫ではありませんか。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: And despite that, unable to abandon your pride, you pushed away the hands reaching out to help you. Utter foolishness. You're free to become a stain on the floor of your room, but the people you've left behind will suffer for it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでもプライドは捨てきれず、
救いの手も振り払ってしまうという
愚かの極み。
あなたたちが部屋で床の染みになり果てるのは勝手ですが、
残された人たちはいい迷惑です。

text_block_list.name: Shut-ins
text_block_list.text: GWAAAAH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐはあぁっ！！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: If you're going to burden others whether you live or die, then at least repay one thing you owe your friends.
text_block_list.orig_text:
生きていても死んでいても迷惑をかけるなら、
せめてご友人に借りの一つでも返したらどうなんです？

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Now choose: will you disappear into the depths of despair as filth, or will you maggots try spreading your wings once more?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さあ選びなさい、
どん底で汚物として消えてしまうのか、
それとも
虫らしくもう一度羽ばたいてみせるのかを。

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's fine. She's right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いや、
いいんだ。
その子の言うとおりだ。

text_block_list.name: Former Student
text_block_list.text: We knew all along. That we weren't anything special.
text_block_list.orig_text:
僕たちだって分かってたさ。
自分が特別なんかじゃないってことをね。

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: But, you know, I didn't want to admit it. Because that was everything to me. If I faced reality, I would be forced to confront the truth whether I liked it or not.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもよぉ、
認めたくなかったんだよ。
それだけが俺の全てだったからな。
現実と向き合えば、
イヤでも事実を突きつけられちまう。

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: So I holed up in my room, running away from reality and from my friends. But... that's all over now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、
部屋に引きこもって
現実から、
そして
友人からも逃げ続けた。
でも……
それももう終わりだ。

text_block_list.name: Former Student
text_block_list.text: After all, the cheap pride I'd clung to for dear life has been utterly destroyed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
後生大事に抱え続けた安いプライドは、
完膚なきまでに壊されたからな。

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: Yeah, my body feels so light, like I've been freed from shackles. You're really something, sis... no, instructor.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
まるで足枷がとれたみたいに体が軽いぞ。
全く大したもんだぜ姉ちゃん……
いや、
教官よぉ。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: That's a given. I'm the "Destroyer", which means I excel at breaking things. Now, starting tomorrow, we will begin your special training. Be prepared, kus kus.
text_block_list.orig_text:
当然ですわ。
私は
「壊し屋」、
壊すのは得意ですから。
さあ、
明日から特訓です。
せいぜい覚悟してくださいね、
クスクス。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Kus kus! Good morning, everyone. It's admirable that you all came without running away. Now, let's get started. I'd like you all to use this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
クスクス、
みなさん
おはようございます。
逃げずに来られて立派ですわ。
ではさっそく、
みなさんにはこちらをやっていただきます。

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: This is... an axe, isn't it? What are we supposed to do with...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これって……
斧、
だよな。
これでいったい何を……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Keep swinging this. All day long. Nothing but that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これを振り続けてください。
一日中、
ただひたすらに。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: There's no quota for the number of times you have to do it. Swing it at your own pace. You can take breaks if you like. Stop if your hands start to hurt.
text_block_list.orig_text:
回数のノルマはありません。
自分のペースで振ってください。
休憩をはさんで構いません。
手が痛くなったら止めていいですよ。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: However, please swing it seriously and without cutting corners. If you were to break that rule... Kus kus.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですが、
一回一回真面目に、
手を抜かずに振ってください。
それが守られない場合は……
クスクス。

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: Hey, this is bad. The instructor's serious...! Looks like we have no choice but to take this seriously.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいヤベェぞ、
教官のヤツ本気だぞ……
こいつは
真面目にやるしかねえな。

text_block_list.name: Former Student
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... It's not so bad to get some exercise once in a while... WAIT, IT'S HEAVY! Ugh... This is going to be a hassle...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
たまには体を動かすのも悪くないか……
って
、
重っ！
くぅ……
これは
大変なことになったな……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Following Eriko's instructions, the three continued to swing their axes relentlessly. After several days had passed...
text_block_list.orig_text:
エリコの指示の通り、３人はひたすら斧を振り続けた。
そうして数日が経った頃──

text_block_list.name: 元学生
text_block_list.text:
ふっ、
ふっ！
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっ、
ふっ！

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: Man... you've gotten quite good at practicing your swing. To be honest, I thought you'd give up halfway through.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
お前、
素振り上手くなったな。
正直途中で音を上げるかと思ってたぜ。

text_block_list.name: Former Student
text_block_list.text: The first days, I thought I was going to die from muscle soreness, but you guys taught me how I should move my body. Thank you both.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最初の数日は筋肉痛で死ぬかと思ったけど、
君らが
体の動かし方を教えてくれたからね。
ありがとう、
二人とも。

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: Hah! Hehehe, it's no biggie...
text_block_list.orig_text:
へ、
へへ、
よせやい……

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: Back to you. Practice swings are monotonous work, after all. I can only be grateful that someone as knowledgeable as you is around so we can pass time hearing interesting stories.
text_block_list.orig_text:
助かるのはこっちも同じだ。
素振りは単調な作業だからな。
物知りのあんたが
色々面白い話を
聞かせてくれるのは
本気でありがたい。

text_block_list.name: Former Student
text_block_list.text: I-I see. Back then, I only thought about writing excellent papers or getting the top score on exams. I didn't realize there were other ways to use my intellect.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうか。
昔は優れた論文を書くとか、
試験でトップをとるとかしか考えてなかったからさ。
こういう役立て方もあるもんなんだな。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Kus kus. It seems as if things are going as planned.
text_block_list.orig_text:
クスクス。
なかなか順調そうですね。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: This training isn't to prepare new recruits for combat, so it's fine. The goal is simply to get the three of them moving their bodies as much as possible.
text_block_list.orig_text:
新兵の戦闘訓練ではありませんから
問題ありませんわ。
目的は３人にひたすら体を動かしてもらうことですから。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: By having them swing an axe, we'll help them retrain their sluggish bodies and minds. If they dedicate themselves seriously, they won't fall into negative thinking.
text_block_list.orig_text:
斧を振らせることで、
なまり切った体と思考を鍛え直してもらいます。
真面目に打ち込んでいれば
ネガティブな思考に陥ることもないでしょう。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: It was a pleasant miscalculation that the three of them became more comfortable with each other and no longer found the simple tasks burdensome. Now I don't have to worry about anyone giving up halfway through.
text_block_list.orig_text:
３人が打ち解けて
単純作業が苦でなくなったのもうれしい誤算でした。
これで途中で投げ出す心配はなくなりましたわ。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Well... it is a shame that the special medicine I had planned to use in case of problems will probably never get a chance to be used. Kus kus.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
問題が起きた時に使おうと思っていた特製の薬が
出番がないまま終わりそうなのが残念ですが。
クスクス。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A little while later, one night...
text_block_list.orig_text: それからまたしばらくの時が経ったある夜のこと──

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: W-WHOAAAA! We did it... WE REALLY DID IT! WE TOOK DOWN A MONSTER!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うおおおー！　
やった……
やったぞ！
魔物を倒したぞー！

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: *sigh* That was tough... I wasn't sure what'd happen when the instructor told us to go defeat monsters, but it turns out it's not a big deal.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
しんどかった……
教官に魔物を倒してこいって言われたときは
どうなるかと思ったけど、
案外
できるもんだな。

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: Then again, it would have been impossible without your precise leadership and support.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もっとも、
お前の的確な指揮とサポートがなきゃ
とても無理だったけどな。

text_block_list.name: Former Student
text_block_list.text: No, it was because you kept them distracted with your footwork. Thanks to you, I was able to give instructions calmly. You're a lifesaver.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
君が脚でかく乱してくれたからだよ。
おかげで落ち着いて指示が出せた。
助かったよ。

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey... you should also praise me for fighting on the front lines!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいおい、
前線で戦い続けた俺も
ちゃんとほめろよな！

text_block_list.name: Shut-ins
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha!
text_block_list.orig_text: はははは！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Former Student
text_block_list.text: C-Crap, we didn't finish it off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
し、
しまった、
倒し切れてなかったのか！

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: No good, I'm out of stamina...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やべえ、
もう
体力が……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: You still haven't practiced enough. HAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだまだ素振りが足りませんわ。
ふっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: Instructor! Y-You saved us...
text_block_list.orig_text:
教官！　
……た、
助かったよ……

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: Sorry, we got carried away...
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪ぃ、
俺ら浮かれちまって……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Kus kus. Cleaning up after inexperienced students is part of the job. Don't worry about it. But...
text_block_list.orig_text:
クスクス、
未熟な教え子の後始末も仕事の内です。
気にすることはありません。
でも──

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: You were all able to bring out your unique qualities back there. Now that you've learned how to use your strengths and where they shine, perhaps there's no need to return to those dark little rooms anymore?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みなさん自身の持ち味は出せていましたわ。
能力の活かし方、
使いどころがわかったのなら、
もうあんな暗くて狭い部屋に戻らなくてもいいのではありませんか？

text_block_list.name: Former Student
text_block_list.text: I-Instructor...
text_block_list.orig_text:
きょ、
教官……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: I'm getting tired of looking after you all. Now, feel free to live as you please. Until next time...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そろそろあなたたちの面倒を見るのも飽きてきました。
あとはどうぞお好きに生きてください。
それでは──

text_block_list.name: Shut-ins
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!
text_block_list.orig_text: ありがとうございましたー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Then, after a while...
text_block_list.orig_text: それからしばしの後──

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Oh my, those people are...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おや、
あれは……

text_block_list.name: Former Student
text_block_list.text: Honestly, you guys pushed me into this, but it's a bit too difficult a mission for us to take on...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく、
君たちに押し切られてしまったけど
僕らが受けるには
いささか難易度が高い任務だよ……

text_block_list.name: Former Martial Artist
text_block_list.text: Now, now, we're relying on your brains to get us through it. Counting on you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあまあ、
そこはお前の頭脳に期待してんだ。
頼むぜ？

text_block_list.name: Former Athlete
text_block_list.text: It's okay. With the three of us, I'm certain... we will be fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫、
俺たち３人ならきっと
大丈夫だ。

text_block_list.name: Former Student
text_block_list.text: Good grief. Then, first up... let's have a strategy meeting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれやれ。
それじゃあまずは
作戦会議といこうか。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Kus kus. It seems as if my role as an instructor is done.
text_block_list.orig_text:
クスクス、
どうやらもう
教官の出番はなさそうですね。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Seeing her students' promising futures, Eriko secretly smiled.
text_block_list.orig_text: 教え子たちの前途ある姿を見て、秘かにほほ笑むエリコだった。
